behaviors.assignee-filter: Filter the seeded task board by a person or by Unassigned, with each assignee option showing its task count.
behaviors.search-assignees: Search for a person in the assignee filter using the Find a person field.
behaviors.combine-filters: Apply an assignee filter together with a status filter to narrow the visible tasks.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear active filters to restore all tasks, including from the no-results state.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Show a person-specific empty message when filtering for a seeded assignee with no assigned tasks.

history.notes: Assumes the Assignee dropdown exposes its trigger as a button named “Assignee” and renders option labels as clickable text; task counts are visible in the open list. The counts predicate checks the list text while it remains open, and exact task headings identify seeded cards.

The assignee control is a custom dropdown whose button has no accessible name, so the script locates `.dd-button` and scopes option text to `.dd`. Counts are checked while the dropdown is open; the option list is opened inside that check because this UI only renders the options on demand.
